device.basis: Still development engine of X-T20 2.11 (step marker 0x06023300): started by +0x00 bit 0, finishes with status +0x20 bit 0 and interrupt 127; +0x00 bit 31 reads set when idle and +0x1c reads 0x01000100 (ready). run ticks are xpro-lab's 3 ms engine step. The engine computes nothing; its buffers come from RAM job descriptors that are not decoded.
